app_tagline: Your AT Protocol data, as an app
app_intro: Open any account to browse its collections and records. Each record is shown using the lexicon its collection publishes.
actor_search_invalid: That isn't a handle, a DID or an at:// URI
repo_collections_empty: This repo has no records yet.
lexicon_missing: No lexicon is published for {nsid}, so its records are shown as plain data.
session_sign_in_hint: Signing in only proves who you are. enform asks for permission to write the first time you create, edit or delete something.
permission_collection: enform will ask your server for permission to {action} records in {collection}, and nothing else.
permission_all_collections: {collection} isn't one of the collections enform declares, so your server can only grant permission to {action} records in all your collections at once.
record_delete_confirm: {rkey} will be removed from {collection} in your repo. This can't be undone.
